# noqeri/toml 0.5.0

TOML subset: quote-aware key/value delimiter scans, basic boolean token validation and safe line classification; not a full TOML parser.

This package retains 0.4.0 APIs and adds real native Noqeri operations without Node.js. It is GPL-3.0-only. The regression source has not been executed against a local Noqeri compiler. Do not interpret an extern declaration as an implemented native host feature.
